note: _isti sunt dii tui Israel_ – these are your gods, Israel. Note that God (who is speaking) does not simply repeat what Aaron said (_hi sunt dii_ […], Exod 32:4); instead, God uses _iste_ which has a derogatory connotation in Latin. – Matthew A. Kraus: _Jewish, Christian, and Classical Exegetical Traditions in Jerome’s Translation of the Book of Exodus: Translation Technique and the Vulgate_. Leiden 2017 (xiii, 266 pp.), pp. 200–201.
